Horse_Grinding_Teeth.description: The Horse_Grinding_Teeth is a fearsome cephalon with a maw bristling with jagged, grinding teeth, designed to crush bones and gnaw through the toughest hides, enhancing its endurance and survival capabilities in the harshest terrains.

Boar_Tusked_Underbite.description: Enveloped in a thick, bristly mane, the Boar_Tusked_Underbite protrudes a gnarled, tusky maw that pierces through flesh with ease, its formidable underbite and piercing bite leaving enemies bleeding and weakened, while its sheer strength and agility make it a fearsome adversary in close combat.

Camel_Tough_Leathery_Lips.description: Thick, leathery lips that resemble those of a desert-dwelling camel, these tough appendages not only serve to filter out the harshest of elements but also grant their bearer a significant boost in constitution, enabling them to endure relentless assaults and resist the searing touch of flames.

Hippopotamus_Massive_Gape.description: This monstrous maw, a testament to primal strength and sheer force, yawns wide with rows of jagged teeth that promise to crush bones and rend flesh, embodying the raw power and unyielding nature of its behemoth form.

Mule_Stubborn_Jaws.description: Embedded within the thick, calloused jaw of this creature is an unyielding will, manifesting in a set of formidable teeth capable of crushing the toughest of materials. Its cephalon, a fusion of ungulate and cephalic traits, houses a resilient mind that enhances both its physical strength and mental fortitude, granting it the ability to endure the most grueling of battles with a relentless bite and unshakable resolve.

Moose_Prehensile_Upper_Lip.description: This prehensile upper lip, a marvel of ungulate evolution, grants the moose unparalleled dexterity and reach, allowing it to manipulate its environment with ease and snatch away prey or objects with lightning-fast precision.

Giraffe_Prehensile_Tongue.description: This prehensile tongue, a marvel of ungulate evolution, coils and uncoils with uncanny dexterity, granting the giraffe not only a formidable reach to pluck leaves from the highest branches but also the agility to snatch items from the ground or manipulate objects with lightning-fast precision.

Deer_Delicate_Nibbling_Lips.description: These delicate lips, adorned with soft, velvet-like skin, are the front line of a creature that combines the grace and speed of an ungulate with the cunning and dexterity of a predator, enhancing the agility and dexterity of the host with every swift, precise movement.

Zombie_Ox_Rotting_Maw.description: The Zombie Ox Rotting Maw is a vile, undead cephalon with a gaping, festering mouth that drips with toxic ichor, capable of spewing a poisonous cloud to wither its foes, while its own corrupted flesh grants resistance to the very toxins it excretes.

Spectral_Steed_Ghost_Teeth.description: Emerging from the spectral maw of the Cephalon, these ghostly teeth, reminiscent of an undead ungulate's jaw, shimmer with a faint, arcane glow, granting their bearer a chilling bite that can pierce even the thickest armor and bestow a touch of spectral wisdom and strength.
